name: Travel Through Caradhras
oracle_text:
Council's dilemma — Starting with you, each player votes for Redhorn Pass or Mines of Moria. For each Redhorn Pass vote, search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you search your library this way, shuffle. For each Mines of Moria vote, return a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Exile Travel Through Caradhras.

needs.what: a voting op: starting with the controller and proceeding in turn order, each player publicly chooses one of N named options (here 'Redhorn Pass' or 'Mines of Moria'); the op binds the tally per option (e.g. as: 'votes' giving {binding: 'votes.redhorn_pass'} / {binding: 'votes.mines_of_moria'}) so later effects in the same spell can use each count as an amount -- here a search_library of basic lands to the battlefield tapped with count = the Redhorn tally (shuffle only if that tally > 0), and a return of that many chosen cards from your graveyard to hand
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op in reference casts a vote and value_keys has no vote count; choose_mode is one chooser picking modes, and for_each_player + choose_mode cannot accumulate a per-option tally into a value. join_forces pools mana payments, not choices. Once the tally exists the rest looks expressible: search_library (selector basic Land, destination battlefield, tapped, shuffle) with count from the binding inside an if on tally > 0, a return_from_graveyard/search_zones over your graveyard to hand for the other tally, and exiles_itself for the last line
